title: Duplicate stage-change events after the relay restart
area: Events and messaging: outbox, Kafka, consumers
scenario: After the 14:02 rollout of outbox-relay, opportunity timelines show 212 stage changes twice and the deal desk got duplicate emails. The consumer team says their event_id dedupe is on; the broker had a planned restart and a latency spike at the same minute. You get both relay pods' logs, the consumer log, an outbox dump and broker metrics.
task: Find why duplicates reached the timeline despite consumer dedupe, with evidence
Fix the relay: stable message identity, a conditional claim, per-row completion that respects lease ownership
Explain what is expected at-least-once behavior and what was a bug
Write ANSWER.md, including the red herring
acceptance: A relay killed mid-batch and restarted leads to every event applied exactly once downstream
Message ids equal outbox event ids; a crash republishes at most the in-flight row
A relay that lost its lease stops publishing; per-aggregate order preserved
ANSWER.md names the root cause with log evidence

practices.label: Week 5 Tue - dual writes and the transactional outbox
Week 5 Wed - idempotent consumers, DLQ, event design
